body_bound.scope: Conservative primitive-box planar bound at nominal joints; not a measured physical robot radius

nominal_pentagon_audit.limits: Nominal common-heading same-speed circle-prior compatibility only; no five-robot closed-loop or physical uncertainty guarantee

stationary_sensor_audit.scope:
Five stationary robots: independently audit each own scan/peer-state pipeline.

This evaluation harness collects scans for checking only. It runs no controller
and publishes no commands or fused perception to robots. It is NOT five-robot
dynamic closed-loop validation. Production geometry functions/parameters reused.

nominal_formation_result.scope: Five-robot empty-world nominal tracking test; NOT new five-robot avoidance.

model_audit.interpretation:
Replay recorded first-command bounds/selected safety model on exact inputs.

Only statuses with an adopted validated command are checked. Deadline stops
are counted separately; zero commands are not silently certified as safe.
This checks the sampled model, not continuous or physical safety.

limits: Nominal empty-world five-robot compatibility is not new five-robot dynamic avoidance
Smaller planning extras failed frozen continuity/compactness rules and must not replace validated entry
Startup readiness settling is optional default0;0.8s used only in new nominal audit to allow original track timeout/consistent masks
First nominal evaluation had invalid wall-time truth clock; control CSV preserved, no result invented
Primitive URDF bound/circle proxies do not guarantee real attachments, localization drift or continuous contact safety
Independent audit collects each own scan separately; no fused perception is sent to controllers
No physical experiments or five-robot spatial-pass enablement
